release_notes: Aion 1.0.0 — First stable release. Immutable root filesystem, Btrfs snapshot-based atomic updates, OTA incremental patching, and desktop environment.
full_release_notes:
Aion 1.0.0 Stable Release

Features:
- Immutable root filesystem with dm-verity
- Btrfs snapshot-based atomic updates
- OTA incremental patching (xdelta3 diffs)
- Automatic rollback on boot failure
- GRUB bootloader with snapshot selection
- systemd-based service management
- Desktop environment (Hyprland + Waybar)
- Package management via pacman
- Secure boot support

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed snapshot cleanup not running on timer
- Fixed network manager restart after rollback
- Fixed bootloader entry ordering

Known Issues:
- First boot may take longer while generating initramfs
- Secure boot requires manual key enrollment on first install
